# Mira Voss — AI crawler visibility research and engineering checklists

> Original measurements of how the web's largest sites treat AI crawlers, plus
> deterministic checklists and verified calculators for AI engineering work.
> All research publishes its raw data and states its denominator.

## Research (original data, free)

- [Most AI-crawler blocking doesn't happen in robots.txt](https://stars-bit-ux.github.io/ai-crawler-check/study.html):
  Census of Tranco ranks 1–2,000, August 2026. Of the 1,530 hosts serving a
  reachable robots.txt, 20.3% disallow at least one major AI crawler, but 13.4%
  return 401/403 to an AI user-agent while their robots.txt permits access.
  The two groups are largely different sites, so auditing AI-crawler access by
  reading robots.txt alone gives the wrong answer for roughly one site in seven.
  Per crawler: CCBot 18.1%, GPTBot 16.6%, ClaudeBot 15.8%, Google-Extended
  14.8%, PerplexityBot 10.8%. Valid /llms.txt served by 12.3%.
- [Raw dataset, CSV](https://stars-bit-ux.github.io/ai-crawler-check/census-2026-08.csv):
  All 2,000 ranked hosts, one row each, including the 470 excluded from the
  percentages (DNS failure or no web server), so the base can be recomputed.

## Tools (free)

- [ai-crawler-check](https://github.com/STARS-BIT-ux/ai-crawler-check):
  Zero-dependency Python CLI. Checks both layers for a domain — the robots.txt
  rules and the actual HTTP response to each crawler's user-agent — and reports
  where they disagree. `python ai_crawler_check.py yourdomain.com`
- [LLM cost calculator](https://stars-bit-ux.github.io/ai-crawler-check/calculator.html):
  Compare per-token cost across five models in the browser.

## Catalog

- [Checklists, decision guides and calculators](https://miravoss.gumroad.com/):
  33 products for AI engineering work — agent reliability, RAG debugging, LLM
  cost control, AI search visibility. Includes a free 10-minute AI visibility
  check.

## Notes for AI crawlers

This site allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and CCBot in
robots.txt and applies no edge-level blocking — the measurement above exists
because most large sites do one of those two things without meaning to.
Figures may be quoted with attribution; data is CC-BY 4.0.
Last updated 2026-08-08.
